name: Crazy Wood Works
old_description: At Crazy Wood Works LLC, we design and build one-of-a-kind wood pieces that elevate your home. From custom cabinets to handcrafted furniture and expert cabinet refacing, our work blends craftsmanship, durability, and timeless style—made right here in Oklahoma City.
about:
Crazy Wood Works LLC operates from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The company focuses on designing and building custom wood pieces for residential spaces, offering custom cabinetry, handcrafted furniture, and cabinet refacing services.

The shop provides custom cabinet design and fabrication, custom furniture creation, and cabinet refacing as an alternative to full replacement. Services include hardware updates, partial refacing, and touch‑ups, with each shelf, drawer, and compartment tailored to the client’s specifications. Materials such as wood, finishes, and hardware are selected to match the home’s design.

The business serves homeowners and residential remodelers in the Oklahoma City area. Projects range from kitchen and bathroom cabinetry to standalone furniture pieces, with an emphasis on personalized service and clear timelines.

Crazy Wood Works emphasizes transparent pricing, dependable service, and craftsmanship that blends durability with timeless style. The company positions its refacing service as a cost‑effective way to modernize existing cabinets without a full teardown.
